ReservationRequestWorkﬂow
1. Send “request received” email to the customer.
2. Wait for signal routed_to_providers  or reservation_request_closed . Open/custom requests wait
indeﬁnitely.
3. On routing, start one child OfferingLifecycleWorkflow  per offering.
4. Wait until any child is Contracted, all children ﬁnish, or the parent is closed.
5. If one contracts: cancel siblings (superseded) and approve the request.
6. If all expire: send one consolidated customer expiry email and expire the request.
7. Closure reasons send emails: Cancelled (customer + NCPs), Rejected, Matched,
Unserviceable.
Signals: routed_to_providers , reservation_request_closed . Child workﬂow retry up to 100 attempts;
expire activity 20 attempts over about 75 minutes.
OfferingLifecycleWorkﬂow
1. Send the magic-link email (critical retry policy).
2. Acceptance phase (7 days by default): reminder 3 days before; on timeout expire the offering
and email the NCP.
3. On provider_accepted : send the introduction email; start the contract phase (45 days).
4. Reminder 3 days before contract expiry; on timeout expire and email.
5. On offering_contracted : send contracted email. On reject or cancel: handle and email
(superseded if a sibling won).
Signals: provider_accepted , acceptance_expiry_extended , contract_expiry_extended ,
offering_contracted , offering_rejected , offering_cancelled .
CsvImportWorkﬂow
VALIDATING →  IMPORTING →  (if future rows) PENDING_REVIEW: email admins and wait for
approve_import  / reject_import  →  activate or reject offerings →  email the NCP. Activities:
validate_csv , execute_atomic_import , activate_offerings , reject_offerings ,
update_import_job_status , notify_admin_for_review , notify_provider_result . Workﬂow max attempts
1; import activities 3 attempts.
ProviderOnboardingWorkﬂow
validate_provider_csv  →  execute_provider_onboarding  (30-minute timeout) →
notify_onboarding_complete  (sent even on failure). 3 attempts; validation errors are not retried.
Salesforce workﬂows
SfdcCreateBatchWorkflow  drains the salesforce_create_sync  outbox. Create mode retries 13
times every 5 minutes; status mode runs once per tick. Gated by SFDC_SYNC_ENABLED ; when
false, schedules are deleted and the workﬂow is not registered.
SfdcPartnerDomainSyncWorkflow  is gated by SFDC_PARTNER_DOMAIN_SYNC_ENABLED . It refuses empty
or suspiciously shrunk snapshots so partners are not mass-demoted.
Retry policies (shared/workflows/workflow_common/retry.py )
Policy Budget Used for
NOTIFICATION_RETRY_POLICY 5 attempts, ~2.5 min Ordinary email
Policy Budget Used for
CRITICAL_NOTIFICATION_RETRY_POLICY 10 attempts, ~25 min Magic-link email
STATUS_UPDATE_RETRY_POLICY 5 attempts, ~1 min Intermediate import status
TERMINAL_STATUS_UPDATE_RETRY_POLICY 8 attempts, ~20 min Final import status
Abandoned steps increment clustruffle_workflow_activity_abandoned  and can be queried with
get_abandoned_steps .
Viewing workﬂows locally
Temporal UI: http://localhost:7600 . Temporal gRPC: localhost:7233 . Run the worker on your
laptop with make worker .
